complexity.notes: Character stack pops M elements immediately whenever suffix matches part.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-allocating a new string upon each substring removal takes O(N^2) time due to continuous copying.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Using a character stack achieves O(N * M) time in the worst case with O(N) space, where M is part length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize that a stack maintains prefixes and allows O(M) suffix inspection.
